subject: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions

Team —

With QBR prep on the calendar this week I want to lock the headcount ask we present to the Execs. Please see the attached high-level plan (headcount_plan_q2.xlsx) — it includes open reqs, current pipeline, and suggested priority labels.

High-level proposal:
- Implement a temporary hiring freeze for non-critical backfills through the end of Q2 (we can revisit in July).
- Allow explicit exceptions for roles that materially impact revenue or production stability.

Current open requisitions I think warrant discussion:
- REQ-4782 (ML Infra engineer) — production stability / latency work, impact on Dedicated throughput.
- REQ-4821 (Sales AE) — quota-bearing role tied to two large pipeline opportunities (see notes).
- REQ-4810 (Customer Success backfill) — lower immediate lift; candidate pipeline thin.

Asks:
1) Vivek — confirm whether REQ-4782 is critical for Q2 milestones and whether delaying will impact infra SLAs.
2) Lauren — advise whether delaying the sales AE would risk losing the two named deals (DEAL-3129 / DEAL-3134).
3) Dev — recruiting ETA and ability to expedite exceptions if approved.

If we can call the freeze + exceptions now I will include the wording in the QBR slide deck and the Exec summary. Please reply with approvals / objections and any metrics (cost delta, SLA risk) by EOD.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0149

Attachment: headcount_plan_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions

On Mon, Mar 22, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> With QBR prep on the calendar this week I want to lock the headcount ask we present to the Execs. Please see the attached high-level plan (headcount_plan_q2.xlsx) — it includes open reqs, current pipeline, and suggested priority labels.

Thanks for the summary. Quick read: I agree with a conservative freeze broadly, but strongly recommend an exception for REQ-4782 (ML Infra). Two reasons:
1) We have a pending cadence of kernel upgrades and the current on-call rotation is already stretched; delaying will increase MTTR risk for live nodes.
2) There's a measurable throughput lift tied to the Dedicated capacity project that goes live late May — we need at least one more senior infra hire to own the rollout and debugging.

I don't think REQ-4810 (CS backfill) is urgent; we can backfill later in the quarter. For REQ-4821 (Sales AE) I'm neutral until Lauren confirms revenue exposure.

Attached a quick capacity impact calc to show potential SLA exposure if we hold REQ-4782 (capacity_impact_calc.pdf).

Action items for me:
- I will quantify expected SLA delta and provide a cost vs. risk number by EOD Wed (2026-03-24).
- If exception approved, recommend using a contractor-to-perm for faster ramp (budget permitting).

Vivek
VP, Infrastructure
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: capacity_impact_calc.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions

On Mon, Mar 22, 2026 at 10:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the summary. Quick read: I agree with a conservative freeze broadly, but strongly recommend an exception for REQ-4782 (ML Infra).

Marissa — short version from Sales: we need to prioritize REQ-4821 (Sales AE). That role is tied to two late-stage opportunities (DEAL-3129 and DEAL-3134) that would flip ARR materially this quarter if staffed. If we delay, recruiting will lose momentum with active candidates and it will push any ramp into next quarter, which is bad for our QBR story.

I support allowing exceptions for revenue-impacting roles. If the Execs need a clear ask, present REQ-4821 as an exception request with a 6-week hiring SLA target. I can commit to weekly candidate screening with recruiting until we fill.

One caveat: don't greenlight multiple sales hires as exceptions; keep it tightly scoped to confirmed revenue opportunities.

- Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

P.S. linking DEAL-3129 in HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-3129

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: hirewell@hirewell.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions

Marissa / team —

Recruiting perspective: we can implement a freeze in Greenhouse immediately and flag exceptions as expedited. Current status:
- REQ-4782 (ML Infra): 3 active candidates in pipeline (1 final loop), can close in 3-4 weeks if prioritized.
- REQ-4821 (Sales AE): 2 strong candidates, both in recruiter-screen stage — 4-6 week close if we prioritize screening and on-site schedule slots.
- REQ-4810 (CS backfill): no active strong pipeline; deprioritize for now.

Attached is the candidate tracker export. If you approve exceptions today, HireWell and our internal sourcers will reallocate outreach to hit the 4-week target.

Request: please confirm final exception list (REQ numbers) by EOD so we can update req tags and outreach cadence.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Recruiter (People Ops)
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: candidate_tracker.csv (CSV, 18KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount alignment: proposed temporary freeze & exceptions

Thanks all for fast responses — summarizing final call for the QBR deck.

Decisions (approved by me for the Exec summary):
- Temporary hiring freeze goes into effect immediately for non-critical backfills through 2026-06-30.
- Exceptions approved (will be presented as narrow asks to Execs):
  * REQ-4782 (ML Infra engineer) — exception approved for production stability; Vivek will provide the SLA / cost delta metric by Wed 2026-03-24.
  * REQ-4821 (Sales AE) — exception approved limited to this single quota-bearing role; Lauren to commit to weekly screening and provide hiring acceptance criteria.
- REQ-4810 (CS backfill) will be deferred and re-evaluated in July.

Action items:
- Vivek: SLA / risk quant by 2026-03-24 (to include MTTR delta and estimated contractor cost if needed).
- Dev: tag REQ-4782 and REQ-4821 as "exception - expedited" in Greenhouse and push candidate outreach; provide weekly update to this thread.
- Lauren: share any deal/exec notes for DEAL-3129 that should be included in the Exec packet by Tue noon.

I'll include this language in the QBR slide and add a one-slide appendix with exception rationale. If anyone objects to the approvals above, flag now; otherwise I'll take this as final and move to Exec prep.

Approved —

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations (on behalf of Exec review)
marissa_cole@redwood.com
